Decorative sign posts for Minecraft 1.21.1. A NeoForge-only fork of Gollorum's Signpost mod with the waystone/teleport system removed, intended for use alongside Via Romana for path-network mechanics. Built for a specific modpack - not a general-purpose replacement for a properly ported version of the original.
A library mod to simplify create addon creation on several aspects
